Messages.Author: the1andonlime
Messages.Body:
If I tap IoY to give a Prince +2 strength after strikes are declared, but before strikes are resolved, will that increase in strength affect the damage dealt when the current strike is resolved?

In other words, does IoY work in the same window as Chiropteran Marauder or Claws of the Dead?

> Name: Island of Yiaros
> [AH:R2, CE:R]
> Cardtype: Master
> Clan: Ventrue
> Cost: 2 pool
> Master: unique location.
> You may tap this card to give a vampire you control +X strength for one strike, where X is the number of votes the vampire has (e.g., a prince gets +2 strength).
> Artist: Pat Morrissey
>

Messages.Author: KevinM
Messages.Body:
> the1andonlime wrote:
> In other words, does IoY work in the same window as Chiropteran Marauder or Claws of the Dead?
>
vekn.net/complete-rules-reference

VI.C.1.c is where the "Claws phase" often happens, and IoY works exactly the same way -- as long as you modify the strike resolution before it resolves, then you have timed it correctly.
